package builders

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type Registry struct {
	starters []domain.StarterBuilder
}

func NewRegistry() *Registry {
	return &Registry{
		starters: []domain.StarterBuilder{
			htmlPageShellStarterBuilder{},
			htmlFormStarterBuilder{},
			cssCatalogGridStarterBuilder{},
			jsCartStarterBuilder{},
		},
	}
}

func (registry *Registry) GetStarter(kind string) (domain.StarterBuilder, bool) {
	for _, builder := range registry.starters {
		if builder.Supports(kind) {
			return builder, true
		}
	}
	return nil, false
}

type htmlPageShellConfig struct {
	Title         string `json:"title"`
	IncludeHeader *bool  `json:"include_header"`
	IncludeFooter *bool  `json:"include_footer"`
}

type htmlFormConfig struct {
	Title       string   `json:"title"`
	FieldNames  []string `json:"field_names"`
	SubmitLabel string   `json:"submit_label"`
}

type cssCatalogGridConfig struct {
	CardCount int `json:"card_count"`
	Columns   int `json:"columns"`
}

type jsCartConfig struct {
	Currency string   `json:"currency"`
	Items    []string `json:"items"`
}

type htmlPageShellStarterBuilder struct{}

func (htmlPageShellStarterBuilder) Supports(kind string) bool { return kind == "html_page_shell" }
func (htmlPageShellStarterBuilder) BuildStarter(_ context.Context, input domain.StarterBuildInput) (domain.StarterBuildResult, error) {
	config := decodeConfig(input.ConfigJSON, htmlPageShellConfig{Title: "Page shell"})
	includeHeader := config.IncludeHeader == nil || *config.IncludeHeader
	includeFooter := config.IncludeFooter == nil || *config.IncludeFooter
	var header string
	if includeHeader {
		header = "    <header>\n      <h1>" + config.Title + "</h1>\n    </header>\n"
	}
	var footer string
	if includeFooter {
		footer = "    <footer>\n      <small>Built for " + input.PracticeTaskTheme + "</small>\n    </footer>\n"
	}
	indexHTML := "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"" + input.LanguageCode + "\">\n  <body>\n" + header + "    <main>\n      <section>\n        <p>Implement the page shell.</p>\n      </section>\n    </main>\n" + footer + "  </body>\n</html>\n"
	return domain.StarterBuildResult{
		Files: []domain.WorkspaceFile{
			{Path: "index.html", Content: indexHTML},
		},
		EditableFiles: []string{"index.html"},
		ReadOnlyFiles: []string{},
		Entrypoints:   []string{"index.html"},
		PreviewConfig: map[string]any{"entrypoint": "index.html"},
		Meta:          map[string]any{"kind": input.MilestoneKind},
	}, nil
}

type htmlFormStarterBuilder struct{}

func (htmlFormStarterBuilder) Supports(kind string) bool { return kind == "html_form_basic" }
func (htmlFormStarterBuilder) BuildStarter(_ context.Context, input domain.StarterBuildInput) (domain.StarterBuildResult, error) {
	config := decodeConfig(input.ConfigJSON, htmlFormConfig{Title: "Checkout form", FieldNames: []string{"name", "phone", "address"}, SubmitLabel: "Submit"})
	var fields strings.Builder
	for _, field := range config.FieldNames {
		if field == "address" {
			fields.WriteString("      <label>" + humanizeFieldLabel(field) + "</label>\n      <textarea name=\"" + field + "\"></textarea>\n")
			continue
		}
		fields.WriteString("      <label>" + humanizeFieldLabel(field) + "</label>\n      <input name=\"" + field + "\" />\n")
	}
	indexHTML := "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"" + input.LanguageCode + "\">\n  <body>\n    <main>\n      <form>\n" + fields.String() + "      <button type=\"submit\">" + config.SubmitLabel + "</button>\n      </form>\n    </main>\n  </body>\n</html>\n"
	return domain.StarterBuildResult{
		Files:         []domain.WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: indexHTML}},
		EditableFiles: []string{"index.html"},
		Entrypoints:   []string{"index.html"},
		PreviewConfig: map[string]any{"entrypoint": "index.html"},
		Meta:          map[string]any{"field_names": config.FieldNames},
	}, nil
}

type cssCatalogGridStarterBuilder struct{}

func (cssCatalogGridStarterBuilder) Supports(kind string) bool { return kind == "css_catalog_grid" }
func (cssCatalogGridStarterBuilder) BuildStarter(_ context.Context, input domain.StarterBuildInput) (domain.StarterBuildResult, error) {
	config := decodeConfig(input.ConfigJSON, cssCatalogGridConfig{CardCount: 4, Columns: 3})
	var cards strings.Builder
	for index := 0; index < config.CardCount; index++ {
		cards.WriteString("      <article class=\"catalog-card\">Card " + fmt.Sprintf("%d", index+1) + "</article>\n")
	}
	indexHTML := "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"" + input.LanguageCode + "\">\n  <head>\n    <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"styles.css\" />\n  </head>\n  <body>\n    <main class=\"catalog-grid\">\n" + cards.String() + "    </main>\n  </body>\n</html>\n"
	styles := ".catalog-grid {\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(" + fmt.Sprintf("%d", config.Columns) + ", 1fr);\n  gap: 16px;\n}\n\n.catalog-card {\n  border: 1px solid #ccc;\n  padding: 16px;\n}\n"
	return domain.StarterBuildResult{
		Files: []domain.WorkspaceFile{
			{Path: "index.html", Content: indexHTML},
			{Path: "styles.css", Content: styles},
		},
		EditableFiles: []string{"index.html", "styles.css"},
		Entrypoints:   []string{"index.html"},
		PreviewConfig: map[string]any{"entrypoint": "index.html"},
		Meta:          map[string]any{"columns": config.Columns},
	}, nil
}

type jsCartStarterBuilder struct{}

func (jsCartStarterBuilder) Supports(kind string) bool { return kind == "js_cart_basic" }
func (jsCartStarterBuilder) BuildStarter(_ context.Context, input domain.StarterBuildInput) (domain.StarterBuildResult, error) {
	config := decodeConfig(input.ConfigJSON, jsCartConfig{Currency: "USD", Items: []string{"Product"}})
	var itemMarkup strings.Builder
	for _, item := range config.Items {
		itemMarkup.WriteString("      <button data-add-to-cart=\"" + item + "\">Add " + item + "</button>\n")
	}
	indexHTML := "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"" + input.LanguageCode + "\">\n  <body>\n    <main>\n      <section id=\"catalog\">\n" + itemMarkup.String() + "      </section>\n      <p id=\"cart-total\">0</p>\n      <script src=\"app.js\"></script>\n    </main>\n  </body>\n</html>\n"
	appJS := "const cartTotal = document.querySelector('#cart-total');\nlet total = 0;\ndocument.querySelectorAll('[data-add-to-cart]').forEach((button) => {\n  button.addEventListener('click', () => {\n    total += 1;\n    cartTotal.textContent = String(total);\n  });\n});\n"
	return domain.StarterBuildResult{
		Files: []domain.WorkspaceFile{
			{Path: "index.html", Content: indexHTML},
			{Path: "app.js", Content: appJS},
		},
		EditableFiles: []string{"index.html", "app.js"},
		Entrypoints:   []string{"index.html"},
		PreviewConfig: map[string]any{"entrypoint": "index.html"},
		Meta:          map[string]any{"currency": config.Currency},
	}, nil
}

func decodeConfig[T any](payload json.RawMessage, defaults T) T {
	if len(payload) == 0 {
		return defaults
	}
	decoded := defaults
	_ = json.Unmarshal(payload, &decoded)
	return decoded
}

func humanizeFieldLabel(field string) string {
	field = strings.TrimSpace(field)
	if field == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if len(field) == 1 {
		return strings.ToUpper(field)
	}
	return strings.ToUpper(field[:1]) + field[1:]
}
